value.rationale: The complete effective spectrum for every FO sentence of a natural, two-sorted random height-two DAG at each critical n^{k/(k-1)} threshold is more informative than a single rare-event calculation. It exposes successive logical phases where a rare k-leaf component is detectable but every smaller size is saturated; exact coefficients and all attainable limits are characterized for arbitrary fixed k,c. This is a natural complete classification with future use in sparse random-structure convergence, not a numerical slice or routine table.
